explanation: EXCLURAD computed η radiative corrections with CLAS12 kinematics (bmom=6.53 GeV, vcut=0.166 GeV², model=3/EtaMAID-2023). The delta value (0.9509747313) represents the ratio σ_radiative/σ_Born, indicating ~4.9% reduction from radiative corrections. sigma_Born (0.0071018161 barn) is the unpolarized Born cross section.
